comparison.objective: Identify red reject cartons on a moving line and push them onto a reject table while leaving brown cartons in flow.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed conveyor interception and lateral pushing versus bimanual screen manipulation and geometry-based many-body separation.
comparison.success_condition: Each reject rests on the reject table with monitored legal trajectory; normal cartons must remain on line.
comparison.reason: Both are separation tasks only at a generic classification level; this record tests moving-line selective rejection, not sieve passage and retained workpieces.
